papers.title: Packed Levitated Marker for Entity and Relation Extraction
papers.read_scope: PDF pp1-5: abstract/introduction,3.1levitated-marker mask,3.3subject-oriented packing,3.4complexity and4.1setup. Two-column method text reread with clipping; no complete14page/appendix/code/experiment certification.

findings.source_fact: Subject-oriented packing combines solid subject markers and levitated candidate-object markers to model same-subject span pairs; original contextual states depend on this marker construction.
Adds object-to-subject inverse relation for bidirectional prediction to supplement object emphasis.
End-to-end NER/RE on ACE04/ACE05/SciERC; boundaries/strict relation metrics differ from this frozen40class Re-TACRED Macro protocol.

papers.transfer_limit: Neither same-subject query modeling nor marker-conditioned context is new. Its bidirectional-label construction is not evidence for a universal natural inverse-label law in Re-TACRED. No marker-mask, utility, speed or encoder-equivalence transfer.

papers.title: A Frustratingly Easy Approach for Entity and Relation Extraction
papers.read_scope: PDF p1identity/abstract/intro excerpt;pp2-5body:3.1problem,3.2typed pair-marked encoder,3.3inference approximation and4.1task/metric setup. Figure text seen but diagram geometry not certified; no complete12page/appendix/code/experiment certification.

findings.source_fact: Predicts relations for span pairs, using a separate relation encoder with subject/object and type markers inserted before encoding; motivates different contextual representations for different entity pairs in one sentence.

Efficient approximation ties marker positions to span boundaries and forbids text tokens from attending to markers, making original-text hidden states independent of marker choices while marker states read text and their own query markers.
End-to-end ACE04/ACE05/SciERC and microF1/boundary/strict evaluation, not frozen40class Re-TACRED Macro.

papers.transfer_limit: Query-conditioned contextual H is established classical practice. Shared original-text computation is obtained by changing the attention mask/position construction, not an invariance of the original solid-marker encoder. No existing Q-RMEA evidence transfers to a changed encoder.

papers.title: Complex Embeddings for Simple Link Prediction
papers.read_scope: PDF pp1-4:task,normal-matrix/sign-rank discussion and section3 equations7-11;page4 equation image inspected. Referenced external expressivity proof and remaining6pages not certified; no rank experiment or benchmark reproduction.

findings.source_fact: Classical ComplEx scores directed triples by Re(sum_k w_rk e_sk conjugate(e_ok)), with an explicit expansion into four real multilinear terms.
Purely imaginary relation embedding gives an antisymmetric scorer; real relation embedding gives a symmetric scorer under shared entity embeddings.
Binary multi-relational knowledge-base completion with shared entity embeddings and logistic link; expressivity/sign-rank discussion cites another original proof.

papers.transfer_limit: Complex directionality has classical precedent and does not establish quantum novelty. This signed trilinear scorer is not identical to squared-fidelity word attention or the40signed-value logits; no native-model equivalence/limitation, rank, calibration or task utility follows.
